theorems.name: Submission.weighted_mono_cutoff_limit
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)) (u q G : Ambient n ℓ → ℝ) (ξ : Ambient n ℓ) (σ ρ R A : ℝ), IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ → 0 < σ → σ ≤ ρ → ρ < R → AEStronglyMeasurable u (μ.restrict (closedBall ξ R)) → AEStronglyMeasurable q (μ.restrict (closedBall ξ R)) → (∀ x ∈ closedBall ξ R, |u x| ≤ A ∧ |q x| ≤ 1) → IntegrableOn G (closedBall ξ R) μ → (∀ (ε : ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < ε → (1 + ε) * ρ < R → ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → Antitone φ → (∀ t, t ≤ 1 → φ t = 1) → (∀ t, 1 + ε ≤ t → φ t = 0) → (∫ x, u x * φ (‖x - ξ‖ / ρ) ∂μ) / ρ ^ n - (∫ x, u x * φ (‖x - ξ‖ / σ) ∂μ) / σ ^ n = ∫ x, u x * q x * (∫ τ in Ioc σ ρ, -(‖x - ξ‖ / τ ^ 2) * deriv φ (‖x - ξ‖ / τ) / τ ^ n) ∂μ + ∫ τ in Ioc σ ρ, (∫ x, φ (‖x - ξ‖ / τ) * G x ∂μ) / τ ^ (n + 1)) → IntegrableOn (fun τ ↦ (∫ x in closedBall ξ τ, G x ∂μ) / τ ^ (n + 1)) (Ioc σ ρ) ∧ IntegrableOn (fun x ↦ u x * (q x / ‖x - ξ‖ ^ n)) (closedBall ξ ρ \ closedBall ξ σ) μ ∧ (∫ x in closedBall ξ ρ, u x ∂μ) / ρ ^ n - (∫ x in closedBall ξ σ, u x ∂μ) / σ ^ n = ∫ x in closedBall ξ ρ \ closedBall ξ σ, u x * (q x / ‖x - ξ‖ ^ n) ∂μ + ∫ τ in Ioc σ ρ, (∫ x in closedBall ξ τ, G x ∂μ) / τ ^ (n + 1)
